steps.content: Fighting with this body is not easy. The shackles are much less responsive than usual. The cotton in your head has slid to your belly, and the frantic running has severely worn out the fabric under your feet.

The toy before you looks even more miserable though. The screaming chicken, who calls itself Bass, is now contorted and deformed after the fight. Its neck is almost folded and drooping, but its protruding eyes are still glaring at you indignantly.

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: Haha, dummy, you'll be outta here if you keep going that way! Just like that sheep! Dummy! Only dummies want to get out!

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: Hahahaha! That's why you two are friends! Meanie friends!

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: Never! Disturb! <color=#fb9259>Eve</color>!

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: Bass will get rid of the meanies!
Bass the screaming chicken lets out its final scream, as twisted and sharp as blackboard-scratching nails. Fortunately, it finally faints.

The dull and high-pitched voice makes you instinctively anxious. How is Pepper now? Who exactly is this "Eve" mentioned by the screaming chicken... But you don't have time for that now. A faint glow is coming from the depths of the darkness, where the exit and your companion lie ahead.
Just as you continue moving forward, you hear an unfamiliar childish voice above you.
I'd advise against that.
What kind of expression is that? Don't get me wrong, I've already passed the stage of wanting to be a human being. I don't need your pity.
Before you can decide whether to turn around, a hand reaches down from above, the shadow of the arm almost blocking the dim overhead light. A human arm!

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: Cluck——!
All of a sudden, that hand snatched away the screaming chicken before you almost violently.
Here to look for Bass? Before you let out a sigh of relief, the child speaks again.
If you run away like that like your friend did, all you'll find is death! Oliver will be sad to see that.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: About the factory, the rumors, and my "kind sister" <color=#fb9259>Eve</color>... I can tell you everything you want to know!

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Let's help each other out, you and Oliver!
Not given a chance to think or defend yourself, someone yanks you in the pitch darkness!
The dim overhead light illuminates the face of the person in front of you, the seemingly innocent smile covered by an ominous shadow.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Oh, why are you ignoring me? Haven't you noticed yet?

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Your friend has already turned into a real, motionless toy!
You hold your breath in the darkness, the shackles probing in the sea of your consciousness...
The shackles' link between you and Pepper... is broken?!
